title: Redwood Security & Privacy Review - Zenova Health
summary: Customer wanted to validate Redwood's security posture and privacy commitments for handling PHI/PII in clinical workflows. Discussed SOC 2/ISO certifications, RBAC/SSO (SAML + SCIM), audit logs, data residency options (US/EU), encryption and KMS/HSM integration, and explicit commitments that customer data is not used to train models. Agreed next steps: share SOC 2/ISO reports, KMS integration guide, retention policy docs, and schedule a demo of Private deployment with infra team.
next_steps: Send SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 attestation and pen-test summary (Maya)
